### Items to Raise

- **payment_terms – Clause 4**  
  > You will be paid a total stipend of ₹17,500 (Rupees Seventeen Thousand Five Hundred only), disbursed in instalments tied to project milestones, in line with the payment schedule agreed with the client:  
  > Milestone Description % of Stipend Amount  
  > 1 Agreement signing / internship start 30% ₹5,250  
  > 2 Phase 3 complete – Booking system 20% ₹3,500 ready  
  > 3 Phase 5 complete – Live classes 30% ₹5,250 working  
  > 4 Final delivery and deployment 20% ₹3,500  
  > The stipend will be transferred via bank transfer / UPI to the account details provided by you. The stipend is inclusive of all applicable deductions, if any.  
  **Explanation:** The payment schedule lacks specific dates, net‑payment terms, or penalties for late payment, leaving the intern vulnerable to delayed or withheld stipend. *Consider discussing the inclusion of clear payment dates, net terms (e.g., “payment within 30 days of invoice”), and late‑payment remedies.*

- **other_risk – Clause 7**  
  > Either party may terminate this internship by providing 7 days' written notice. Language Metrics reserves the right to terminate this internship without notice in cases of misconduct, breach of confidentiality, or unsatisfactory performance.  
  **Explanation:** The employer can terminate without notice, creating an imbalance and leaving the intern without compensation or recourse. *You may want to discuss adding a mutual notice period or specifying any severance or compensation due upon termination without notice.*

- **kill_fee – Clause 14**  
  > If this internship is terminated before completion under Clause 7, the stipend payable shall be limited to the milestone(s) actually achieved as of the date of termination, calculated in accordance with the payment schedule in Clause 4; no amount shall be payable for milestones not yet achieved.  
  **Explanation:** There is no provision for a kill fee or compensation for work performed up to termination beyond the milestone payments, which can leave the intern unpaid for effort expended. *Consider discussing the inclusion of a proportional “kill fee” or a minimum compensation for work completed prior to termination.*

LANGUAGE METRICS
Proprietor: Riyansh Kumar Gupta
Ward Number 26, Ram Dham Mandir, Near Shiv Mandir, Bagaha 1, Paschim Champaran, Bihar – 845101
Udyam Reg. No.: UDYAM-BR-38-0073569 | GSTIN: 10CZIPG4144C1Z2 | Email: languagemetrics@gmail.com | www.languagemetrics.in
Letter No.: LM/INT/2026/01
Date: August 21, 2026
To,
Paarth Gupta
Aliganj Road, Gola Gokarannath, Kheri – 262802
B.Tech, Computer Science and Engineering, KIET Group of Institutions
SUBJECT: OFFER OF INTERNSHIP – FULL STACK DEVELOPER INTERN
Dear Paarth,
We are pleased to offer you an internship with LANGUAGE METRICS for the role of Full Stack Developer Intern, in
connection with our language-learning platform project currently under development. This letter sets out the
terms and conditions of your internship.
1. Role and Responsibilities
 Development and maintenance of the frontend UI/UX and user interface, along with the backend API using
Node.js + Express, and the database using PostgreSQL / Supabase with Prisma ORM.
 Integration of core platform features including authentication, booking system, payments through Razor pay,
and the coin system.
 Development of the Teacher and Admin web portals using React.
 Integration of the live class system using relevant API and supporting backend infrastructure.
 Collaboration with the AI Developer on API contracts and end-to-end feature delivery.
2. Duration
 This internship shall commence on the date on which the Intern signs and accepts this Internship Letter and
shall continue for a period of exactly three (3) months from the date of such acceptance.
 The duration may be adjusted by mutual written agreement based on project progress and requirements.
3. Work Mode & Availability
 The Internship shall be conducted on a fully remote basis. The Intern shall be expected to devote
approximately thirty (30) hours per week to the duties and responsibilities assigned under this Internship. The
Intern shall also be required to attend and actively participate in scheduled meetings, progress reviews,
check-ins, stand-up meetings, and other work-related sessions as may be reasonably scheduled or
communicated by the Proprietor from time to time.
 The Intern shall report to Priyanshu Raj, Co-Founder & Technical Lead of Language Metrics, on a weekly
basis and provide updates on assigned tasks and responsibilities.
Ward Number 26, Ram Dham Mandir, Near Shiv Mandir, Bagaha 1, Paschim Champaran, Bihar – 845101 | languagemetrics@gmail.com | www.languagemetrics.in
4. Stipend
You will be paid a total stipend of ₹17,500 (Rupees Seventeen Thousand Five Hundred only), disbursed in
instalments tied to project milestones, in line with the payment schedule agreed with the client:
Milestone Description % of Stipend Amount
1 Agreement signing / internship start 30% ₹5,250
2 Phase 3 complete – Booking system 20% ₹3,500
ready
3 Phase 5 complete – Live classes 30% ₹5,250
working
4 Final delivery and deployment 20% ₹3,500
The stipend will be transferred via bank transfer / UPI to the account details provided by you. The stipend is
inclusive of all applicable deductions, if any.
5. Confidentiality
During and after the internship, you agree to keep confidential all proprietary information, source code,
credentials, business processes, and client (Language Metrics) data that you access in the course of this
internship, and not to disclose or use such information for any purpose outside this engagement.
6. Ownership of Work
All code, designs, documentation, and other work created by the Intern in connection with this Internship shall
be the exclusive property of Language Metrics. The Intern shall not claim ownership of, reproduce, distribute,
or use such work for any personal or external purpose without prior written authorization from Language
Metrics. The Intern agrees to assign any rights or interests they may have in such work to Language Metrics.
7. Termination
Either party may terminate this internship by providing 7 days' written notice. Language Metrics reserves the right
to terminate this internship without notice in cases of misconduct, breach of confidentiality, or unsatisfactory
performance.
8. Certificate of Completion
On successful completion of the internship, you will be issued a Certificate of Internship confirming your role,
duration, and contributions to the project.
9. Professional Conduct
You are expected to maintain professional conduct, comply with reasonable project instructions and security
practices, protect company credentials and systems, and promptly communicate any material issue that may
affect project delivery.
10. Leave / Absence
Any planned leave of absence should be communicated to the Proprietor in advance, so that project timelines
and coverage can be planned accordingly.
11. Company Property & Access
All company credentials, repositories, documents, API keys, and other resources provided to you for the
purposes of this internship must be returned or, where applicable, have access revoked, at the end of the
internship.
Ward Number 26, Ram Dham Mandir, Near Shiv Mandir, Bagaha, Paschim Champaran, Bihar – 845101 | languagemetrics@gmail.com | www.languagemetrics.in
12. No Employment Relationship
This internship is a temporary engagement for the duration stated above and does not constitute, and shall not
be construed as creating, an employer-employee relationship or any right to permanent employment with
Language Metrics, whether during or upon completion of the internship.
13. Point of Contact & Grievance Redressal
For day-to-day project matters, your primary point of contact is Priyanshu Raj, Co-Founder & Technical Lead.
Any concerns or grievances that remain unresolved after being raised with Priyanshu Raj may be escalated to the
Proprietor.
14. Stipend on Early Termination
If this internship is terminated before completion under Clause 7, the stipend payable shall be limited to the
milestone(s) actually achieved as of the date of termination, calculated in accordance with the payment schedule
in Clause 4; no amount shall be payable for milestones not yet achieved.
15. Entire Agreement & Amendment
This letter constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the internship and supersedes
any prior discussions or understandings, whether written or oral. No amendment or modification shall be valid
unless made in writing and signed by both parties.
16. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
This letter shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, and the courts at Bagaha,
West Champaran, Bihar shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes arising out of or in connection with
this internship.
17. Acceptance
Please sign and return a copy of this letter as a token of your acceptance of the above terms and conditions.
For LANGUAGE METRICS,
___________________________
RIYANSH KUMAR GUPTA
Proprietor, Language Metrics
ACCEPTANCE BY INTERN
I, Paarth Gupta, hereby accept the terms and conditions of this internship offer and agree to comply with the
responsibilities and obligations stated in this letter.
Signature: ____________________________ Date: __________________
Ward Number 26, Ram Dham Mandir, Near Shiv Mandir, Bagaha, Paschim Champaran, Bihar – 845101 | languagemetrics@gmail.com | www.languagemetrics.in
